premise: Fox spots something fluffy behind him and chases it round and round; Butterfly lands on it and it stops; Hedgehog explains it has been following him all along, because it is his tail.
inspiration: Aesop's fox-and-tail motifs and the folk dog-chases-tail joke, turned: the silly chase ends in a laugh Fox shares and a dizzy nap.
lesson: It's fine to laugh at yourself.

en-US.title: Fox Chases His Tail
en-US.text: {flower:sway loop 0.3} {butterfly:float loop 0.4} Fox was sitting in the sun when he saw it. Something fluffy. Something orange. Right behind him! He {fox:spin} spun round. It moved! Hey, said Fox. Come here, fluffy thing! And off he went, {fox:spin x3} round and round and round. The fluffy thing stayed just behind him. Always just behind! Hedgehog {hedgehog:pulse} looked up from his nap. Butterfly {butterfly:float 0.6} drifted down to see. The forest went round and round. Then Butterfly {butterfly:hop} landed, soft as a wish, right on the fluffy thing. And it stopped. Fox stopped. He looked over his shoulder. The fluffy thing was attached to him. Fox, said Hedgehog kindly, that's your tail. Fox looked at his tail. His tail looked at Fox. Then Fox {fox:wobble x2} flopped down in the grass, laughing and dizzy. It followed me the whole time, he said. {hedgehog:hearts} They always do, said Hedgehog.

es-ES.title: Zorro persigue su cola
es-ES.text: {flower:sway loop 0.3} {butterfly:float loop 0.4} Zorro estaba sentado al sol cuando lo vio. Algo esponjoso. Algo naranja. ¡Justo detrás de él! {fox:spin} Se dio la vuelta. ¡Se movió! Eh, dijo Zorro. ¡Ven aquí, cosa esponjosa! Y allá que fue, {fox:spin x3} vuelta y vuelta y vuelta. La cosa esponjosa se quedaba justo detrás. ¡Siempre justo detrás! Erizo {hedgehog:pulse} levantó la cabeza de su siesta. Mariposa {butterfly:float 0.6} bajó flotando a ver. El bosque daba vueltas. Entonces Mariposa {butterfly:hop} se posó, suave como un deseo, justo sobre la cosa esponjosa. Y se paró. Zorro se paró. La cosa esponjosa estaba pegada a él. Zorro, dijo Erizo con cariño, eso es tu cola. Zorro miró su cola. Su cola miró a Zorro. Entonces Zorro {fox:wobble x2} se dejó caer en la hierba, riendo y mareado. Me ha seguido todo el rato, dijo. {hedgehog:hearts} Siempre lo hacen, dijo Erizo.
